scope: neuro-native acquired/dynamics-key reading of nociceptor sensitisation; gene-key monogenic pain channelopathies are disease_wp entities, cross-referenced only
firewall: peripheral afferent firing-threshold term only; delta is structural (not a dose); every clinical magnitude is [O]; the felt/affective pain is the Felt Cognition volume's; no molecule designed; nothing prescribes

levers.L1: reduce the inward (excitatory) current (block depolarising Na_V/Ca_V/ASIC/P2X/TRP) -> lower the effective sensitisation bias
levers.L2: increase the outward K+ current (open K_V7) -> hyperpolarise away from yield -> lower the effective bias
levers.L3: remove the up-stream NGF/CGRP sensitising drive -> un-do the sensitisation -> lower the effective bias

de_sensitisation.note: shown once for one element; L1/L2/L3 are identical in direction (all lower b_eff)

channelopathy_anchor.title: Channelopathy direction anchor — measured biology fixes the firing-threshold direction
channelopathy_anchor.axis: the nociceptor firing threshold is the pain knob: lower it -> more pain, raise it -> less pain

anchors.measured_phenotype: congenital insensitivity to pain (no pain under any circumstance)

anchors.threshold_direction: firing threshold lowered (gate opens too easily)

anchors.measured_phenotype: congenital insensitivity to pain with anhidrosis (CIPA)

anchors.threshold_direction: firing threshold RAISED (gate held closed) — the realised analgesic move
anchors.measured_phenotype: approved non-opioid analgesia for moderate-severe acute pain

channelopathy_anchor.reading: The two DNA directions bracket the lever map: a LOF that drives the threshold to infinity ABOLISHES pain (CIP), and a GOF that lowers it CAUSES spontaneous pain (IEM/PEPD). The realised analgesic (Na_V1.8 closed-state stabiliser) sits on the SAME axis, pushed the protective way. So 'raise the firing threshold' is not an analogy — it is the measured pain axis, and the three levers are three ways onto it.

disease_lever_pointers.mechanism: injury up-regulates Na_V1.3/Na_V1.7-Na_V1.8 traffic + NGF drive -> threshold lowered, gain up
disease_lever_pointers.pointer_classes: alpha2delta-1 gabapentinoids (CACNA2D1); Na_V1.8/Na_V1.7-selective (SCN10A/SCN9A); K_V7 openers (KCNQ2/3/5); anti-NGF (NGF/NTRK1)

disease_lever_pointers.mechanism: CGRP sensitising drive lowers the afferent threshold (validated in migraine)

disease_lever_pointers.disorder: Inflammatory / nociplastic pain (tissue acidosis + heat sensitisation)
disease_lever_pointers.mechanism: ASIC/TRPV1 inward current rises with acidosis/heat -> threshold lowered
GOF lowers/sustains the firing gate -> spontaneous/triggered pain (gene-key entity = disease_wp)
presynaptic N-type Ca2+ release (dorsal horn) drives the central gain
